enabled.description: Refers to whether autoscaling is enabled for this {@link App.NodePool}. Note this defaults to true.

strategy.description: Refers to what scaling strategy this {@link App.NodePool} uses

title:
Configuration options for autoscaling {@link App.NodePool}. This includes whether autoscaling should be enabled for
the node pool and on what criteria autoscaling should be triggered.
name: App.NodePool.AutoScaleSpec
